stage: Pre-test mechanism screening, NOT proof of official improvement
hypothesis: The packed path currently serializes AIC Matmul Init/SetOrgShape after all AIV input packing. Move only the first-input-ready wait behind initialization, preserving its position before any input consumption. This may overlap initialization with packing.
official_basis: 60 archived official responses show no attributable improvement at points3/8/13/14; packed code and helper stayed unchanged in the selected anchors. No known hidden point is mapped to this path.
source_change_scope: Only bmms_fused_nz AIC wait placement; all math, dispatch, tiling, resources and precision repair preserved.
precision_set: ALL 200 existing historical manifest entries hitting the packed dispatch; all failures retained; unchanged tolerances; three-call consistency.
performance_set: ALL 8 distinct shapes from those entries, sorted lexicographically, no selection by timings. These are historical development fixtures, NOT a blind set or official hidden shapes.
metric: 160 calls per shape, median last80 msprof Task Duration, ABBA
screen_rule: First FP16 NN across all8. Stop if either order geometric mean exceeds0.98 or any shape exceeds1.03 in both orders. If qualified, run other7 dtype/layout combinations; no posthoc shape removal or dispatch narrowing.
promotion: Screen only. No automatic OJ submission. A final candidate requires full historical+new precision, fixed100 and sixhang regression, direct official baseline comparisons and explicit assessment of s41c precision repair cost. Official15-point results alone establish ranking improvement.
pool_coverage: The unchanged100 shape pool contains ZERO packed-dispatch shapes, so improvement of its geometric mean cannot measure this mechanism. Keep it as regression coverage; do not change its membership.
